description: For a given file path and session key (const uint8_t*), generate a 12-byte nonce using RAND_bytes(). Perform AES-256-GCM encryption using the EVP_CIPHER_CTX interface from libcrypto. Write the encrypted output to a new file with the suffix .PROCESSED appended to the original filename. The file format is: [12-byte nonce][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag]. Then overwrite the original source file with zeros (using a write loop of zeros for the file's original size) and delete it using remove().
name: process_file
